name: intel-mac-monitor
description: Stream Deck plugin showing live CPU/GPU temperature and fan speed on Intel Macs.

scripts.build:helper: cd helper && swift build -c release && cp .build/release/smcreader ../dev.andreisudarikov.intel-mac-monitor.sdPlugin/bin/mac/smcreader
scripts.build:plugin: cd plugin && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:helper && npm run build:plugin
scripts.test: npm run test:helper && npm run test:plugin
